description: Source file implementing a wait counter handler for distributed control plane metrics, including classes and functions for tracking, storing, and retrieving counter data as JSON.

classes.name: CounterData
classes.description: Holds atomic counter metrics for active count, total calls, total time, and max time.

classes.name: CounterDataMapHolder
classes.description: Holds a synchronized map of counter data objects keyed by string.

classes.name: TrackingBackend
classes.description: Backend class that tracks counter metrics, implementing start and stop timing functions.

classes.name: TrackingBackendFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of TrackingBackend.

methods.name: ensureWaitCounterBackendRegistered
methods.description: Registers the wait counter backend if not already registered.

methods.name: getWaitCounterValuesJson
methods.description: Returns all wait counter metrics as a JSON string.
